reviewed_data.composition_policy: Saved values, zeros and NaNs preserved; no filling, balance calculation or normalization.

feature_definitions.log_scan: log10(scan_rate in saved units); missing/nonpositive remains unknown
feature_definitions.log_area: log10(Test_area_cm2 in saved units); missing/nonpositive remains unknown
feature_definitions.log_exposure: log10(CP_time in saved units); missing/nonpositive remains unknown
feature_definitions.log_grit: log10(Prep_grinding_grit in saved units); missing/nonpositive remains unknown
feature_definitions.log_roughness: log10(Prep_Ra_micron in saved units); missing/nonpositive remains unknown
feature_definitions.log_prep_time: log10(Prep_time in saved units); missing/nonpositive remains unknown
feature_definitions.log_heat_hours: log10(heat_treatment_duration_h in saved units); missing/nonpositive remains unknown
feature_definitions.MnS_nitric_prep: sqrt(Mn*S) * indicator(preparation solution contains HNO3); unknown solution stays unknown

sources.topic: Nitric-acid passivation and nonmonotone treatment effects
Surface MnS removal and pitting resistance
Scan-rate dependence of measured pitting potential
Exposure area is not a universal proportional pitting law
Aging-treatment effects depend on microstructure and temperature

limitations: Exploratory study: the base rule was chosen using previous development scores.
Category and source associations do not establish causal material laws.
Positive tungsten/copper rows are sparse; heat measurements are sparse.
Reference electrode labels are excluded; no reference conversion is inferred.

frozen_development_folds.interpretation: Uncertainty from evaluation groups conditional on fitted fold models; does not include training/search instability.

source_publication_blocked_folds.interpretation: Uncertainty from evaluation groups conditional on fitted fold models; does not include training/search instability.
